sub_graphs.title: Cancun Point Evaluation: KZG Proof Verification Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the runtime behavior of the EIP-4844 point evaluation precompile for blob commitment verification

nodes.label: Point Evaluation Precompile Called
nodes.description: Contract call to address 0x0A with KZG proof data

nodes.label: Check Input Length
nodes.description: Verify input is exactly 192 bytes

nodes.label: Invalid Input Length
nodes.description: Input not 192 bytes, raise KZGProofError

nodes.label: Parse Input Fields
nodes.description: Extract: versioned_hash (32), z (32), y (32), commitment (48), proof (48)

nodes.label: Input Fields Parsed
nodes.description: All KZG verification inputs extracted

nodes.label: Compute Versioned Hash from Commitment
nodes.description: Call kzg_commitment_to_versioned_hash() with version byte 0x01

nodes.label: Verify Hash Matches
nodes.description: Compare computed versioned hash with input versioned hash

nodes.label: Versioned Hash Mismatch
nodes.description: Commitment does not match claimed versioned hash, raise KZGProofError

nodes.label: Versioned Hash Verified
nodes.description: Commitment correctly maps to versioned hash

nodes.label: Verify KZG Proof
nodes.description: Call verify_kzg_proof(commitment, z, y, proof) for polynomial evaluation check

nodes.label: KZG Proof Invalid
nodes.description: Proof verification failed, raise KZGProofError

nodes.label: KZG Proof Valid
nodes.description: Proof verifies that polynomial(z) = y for committed polynomial

nodes.label: Construct Output
nodes.description: Build 64-byte output: FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB (32) + BLS_MODULUS (32)

nodes.label: Point Evaluation Success
nodes.description: Return 64-byte output containing field size and modulus constants

external_entities.description: Smart contract or rollup verifying blob data availability

external_entities.name: Blob Transaction Source
external_entities.description: Original blob-carrying transaction providing the commitment

nodes.label: Validation Started
nodes.description: Input received, validation checks required

nodes.label: Validate Input Size
nodes.description: Check input is exactly 192 bytes

nodes.label: Input Size Invalid
nodes.description: Input not 192 bytes, KZGProofError

nodes.label: Validate Versioned Hash Format
nodes.description: Check versioned hash has correct version byte (0x01)

nodes.label: Validate Commitment Format
nodes.description: Verify KZG commitment is valid 48-byte G1 point

nodes.label: Validate Proof Format
nodes.description: Verify KZG proof is valid 48-byte G1 point

nodes.description: Verify z and y are valid BLS12-381 field elements (< BLS_MODULUS)

nodes.label: All Validation Passed
nodes.description: Input structurally valid, proceed to verification

nodes.label: Validation Failed
nodes.description: Input malformed, raise KZGProofError

edges.label: z or y out of range

nodes.description: Exception from KZG library intercepted

ambiguities.text: The relationship between FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB (4096) in output and actual blob field element count is not explicitly linked
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB is a constant that matches the blob polynomial degree, returned for caller convenience

ambiguities.text: The specification does not detail what happens if the BLS12-381 trusted setup is compromised
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume KZG security relies on the trusted setup ceremony being performed correctly with toxic waste destroyed

ambiguities.text: The exact big-endian encoding format for z and y field elements is implied but not explicitly specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume z and y are 32-byte big-endian encoded integers representing BLS12-381 scalar field elements

implicit_assumptions.description: The KZG trusted setup (powers of tau ceremony) was performed correctly and toxic waste was destroyed
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attacker with trapdoor could create false proofs for arbitrary polynomial evaluations, breaking blob data integrity

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot solve the discrete logarithm problem on BLS12-381
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: KZG commitment scheme would be broken, allowing forgery of blob commitments

implicit_assumptions.description: The KZG library implementation is correct and resistant to implementation attacks
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Bugs in pairing or field arithmetic could cause false proof acceptance or rejection

implicit_assumptions.description: Version byte 0x01 correctly identifies KZG commitments and will be updated for future commitment schemes
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Commitment type confusion could allow using wrong verification logic for a commitment
